steps.title: Confirm NWT Business Stream eligibility
steps.description: Plan to start, buy or invest in an NWT business, actively operate it and settle full-time. You need suitable experience and education, CLB/NCLC 4, sufficient operating and settlement resources, and no active application in another nominee program or NTNP stream.

requiredDocuments.title: Language, experience, education and settlement evidence

preparationChecklist.text: Read the current official instructions for this stage.

Missing a deadline or failing to report a material change.

steps.title: Confirm investment, ownership and net-worth thresholds
steps.description: For Yellowknife, commit at least $200,000 equity and show at least $500,000 net worth. Outside Yellowknife, commit at least $100,000 equity and show at least $250,000 net worth. Own at least 33.3 percent unless investing at least $1 million.
